properties.short_description: Indoor ice arena and training center offering public skating, youth hockey programs, pro shop, and on-site restaurant; primary practice facility for the Vegas Golden Knights.
properties.overall_description: City National Arena is a premier indoor ice facility in Las Vegas that serves as the official practice home for the Vegas Golden Knights. The center features two ice rinks, hosting a wide array of activities including public skating, youth hockey leagues, and collegiate games. Visitors can enjoy well-maintained amenities, including an on-site restaurant and a team merchandise shop, making it a comprehensive destination for sports fans and families alike.
properties.ambience_description: The atmosphere is energetic and professional, blending the intensity of competitive sports with a welcoming space for families and casual skaters. It maintains a clean, well-maintained environment where visitors can enjoy both the action on the ice and relaxing dining experiences.
properties.amenities_description: The facility features two professional-grade ice rinks, clean locker rooms with showers, and a pro shop for team merchandise. An on-site restaurant provides dining options for visitors to enjoy while watching games or practice sessions.
properties.unique_selling_points: As the official practice facility for the Vegas Golden Knights, this arena offers a unique professional sports experience alongside comprehensive public ice skating and hockey programs. It seamlessly combines high-level athletic training with community recreational facilities.
properties.neighborhood_description: The arena is situated in a convenient, high-traffic commercial district, offering easy access to various amenities and shopping. It serves as a central hub for sports enthusiasts and families in the Las Vegas valley.
properties.physical_setting_description: Located in a bustling commercial area, this modern indoor facility serves as a primary ice arena and training center. The building houses two ice rinks and is designed as a high-quality venue for both competitive hockey and recreational skating.

entities.name: Las Vegas Ballpark

properties.address: 1650 S Pavilion Center Dr Las Vegas, NV 89135
properties.description: Modern Triple-A baseball stadium in Las Vegas hosting the Las Vegas Aviators, concerts, festivals, and community events with club level seating and suites.
properties.short_description: Modern Triple-A baseball stadium in Las Vegas hosting the Las Vegas Aviators, concerts, festivals, and community events with club level seating and suites.
properties.overall_description: Las Vegas Ballpark is a premier, award-winning Triple-A baseball stadium that serves as the home field for the Las Vegas Aviators. Beyond baseball, the modern facility functions as a versatile venue hosting concerts, community festivals, and holiday-themed events. With its well-maintained architecture, diverse concessions, and premium seating options, it provides a comprehensive entertainment experience for sports fans and local families. Its convenient location and high-quality amenities make it a central hub for community life in the area.
properties.ambience_description: The ballpark features a clean, modern atmosphere that transitions from an energetic sports environment during games to a festive and immersive space during special events. It is a social venue that maintains a welcoming vibe for families and fans alike.
properties.amenities_description: The venue is equipped with a variety of amenities including premium suites, club-level seating, and numerous concession stands offering diverse food and drink options. Visitors also have access to an on-site team store and well-lit parking facilities.
properties.unique_selling_points: Recognized multiple times as the Triple-A Best of the Ballparks, this facility offers a top-tier minor league experience with a stadium design that ensures excellent views from every seat. It seamlessly transforms into a seasonal event destination, most notably hosting immersive light festivals.
properties.neighborhood_description: The surrounding neighborhood is a vibrant and convenient area designed for community engagement and entertainment. It offers easy access to local amenities and serves as a hub for both residents and visitors.
properties.physical_setting_description: A modern, open-air Triple-A baseball stadium situated in an urban commercial district. The facility provides clear sightlines across the field, with mountain vistas visible in the surrounding area.
